data.notes: January’s confirmed public music calendar is sparse, with verified listings centered on local night-ski entertainment rather than major Top of the Mountain concerts.

events.title: Trofana Alm Party de Luxe winter DJ residency
events.summary: Season-long après-ski club residency at one of Ischgl’s flagship party huts, with regular international DJs and late-afternoon-to-midnight dancing during the January ski season.

events.title: fire & ice APRES.SKI winter club nights
events.summary: Nightly club-and-dance residency at fire & ice APRES.SKI, confirmed for the winter season with daily late-night opening and a club/dancing format next to the Silvretta base area.

events.title: Champagnerclub winter late-night DJ residency
events.summary: Daily late-night club residency in Schlosshotel Ischgl’s Champagnerclub, billed with Europe’s top DJs and a first-class club atmosphere from 22:00 to 04:00 through January.

events.title: Freeride Après Clubbing daily DJ residency
events.summary: Daily afternoon-to-late-night après-clubbing residency where DJs drive the dancefloor, positioned as a clubbier alternative to traditional après-ski during the January season.

events.title: Medrig Night Fever
events.summary: Official Paznaun/Ischgl calendar listing for See’s Medrig Night Fever, described as a night event all about music with its own stage, laser show, and performances. The source explicitly lists 06.01.2027 at 19:30.

events.title: Nightshow Ischgl
events.summary: Official Ischgl Nightshow at Prennerhang with ski-school demonstrations and a DJ providing the soundtrack. The source explicitly lists the January date as 05.01.2027 at 21:00, with free admission.

events.title: Niki’s Stadl daily DJ party-hits residency
events.summary: Long-running daily après-ski party residency in central Ischgl, with DJs playing current party hits for the winter crowd every afternoon and evening through January.
